description.en: Original evidence-informed living reconstruction of Pycnodus apodus from Eocene Bolca: a deep compressed body, modest nipping-mouth shape, low median fins and double-emarginate tail.
description.zh: 依据证据创作的始新世博尔卡 Pycnodus apodus 活体复原：侧扁高体、小而略突的口、低长背臀鳍及双凹尾缘。

reconstruction_notes.en: Living soft tissue, pigment, thickness, fin spread and gentle swimming bend are artistic and unverified. Nominal total length 0.24 m +/-15%; no specimen-perfect or internal dentition claim. Paired fins restored despite omission for clarity in Fig7. Tail follows character61 state2; no sharp V-fork.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 活体软组织、颜色、厚度、配对鳍展开及轻微游姿为艺术推定。名义全长0.24米、容差±15%，不声称标本级精度或内部齿系复原。图7为清晰起见省略的配对鳍已补全；尾缘遵循性状61状态2。

author: Leon Made This / s010s
acceptance_scope: Original frozen scoped independent model review with retained advisories; no blanket formal/GPU/neighbor/reproducibility or user visual approval. Website image review remains separate.
scale_scope: Nominal authored display dimensions; not new specimen metrology.
